prompt: I need to name a class that accept request from client and save request body in memory, then launch an internal HTTP service and wait for the real processor to connect. The real processor will get the input, process and return the result through the connection then. After receive the result from the real processor, the class will return the result to the client. Please give me the class name
response: The class you're describing acts as an intermediary, handling client requests and managing an internal connection for processing. A suitable name for this class could be `RequestForwarder`, as it forwards the request to an internal service and then forwards the response back to the client. This name emphasizes its role in directing the flow of data between client and processor.
